_vars.base: Two watercolor river shapes painted in perspective, each receding from a shared foreground meeting point. The left river starts wide at the lower-center, its wash tapering as it winds away toward the upper-left corner. The right river starts equally wide at the same foreground point, its wash tapering as it curves away toward the upper-right. The convergence zone — where the two rivers are at their widest and most vivid — sits near the bottom center. Thin ink lines sketch the river bends. Generous bare parchment all around.
_vars.style: watercolor ink wash illustration on cream parchment paper (#F5EFE3), delicate ink lines tracing the river channels, soft blooming washes with feathered edges, abstract river forms floating on bare parchment, no landscape, no vegetation, no sky, no people, no text, no logos
_vars.neg: aerial top-down view, trees, grass, sky, clouds, horizon, hills, people, figures, text, logos, photorealistic, dark background
